description: Apply visible CPF/phone masks to the public self-registration screen (src/components/MainView/RegisterComponent.vue), reusing the exact pattern from RegisterEmployee.vue by extracting it into a shared util src/utils/masks.ts. The rendered field must show punctuation while the payload sent in registrar() stays digits-only. Independent of FEAT-002 (disjoint files).
steps: Create src/utils/masks.ts exporting three pure functions (no dependencies) with the EXACT logic currently inline in src/components/GestorView/RegisterEmployee.vue: onlyDigits(value: string | null | undefined): string -> (value ?? '').replace(/\D/g, ''); formatCpf(value): masks digits (capped at 11) to 000.000.000-00 using the same length-based slicing as RegisterEmployee; formatPhone(value): progressive (00) 00000-0000 using digits capped at 11, separatorPosition = 5 when 11 digits else 4, same branch logic as RegisterEmployee.

Refactor src/components/GestorView/RegisterEmployee.vue to import { onlyDigits, formatCpf, formatPhone } from '@/utils/masks' and delete the three inline method bodies; keep the cpfInput/phoneInput computed setters and registrar() calling the imported functions. Do NOT change any template markup. This must stay behavior-preserving so its existing spec passes unchanged.

Modify src/components/MainView/RegisterComponent.vue: import { onlyDigits, formatCpf, formatPhone } from '@/utils/masks'. On the CPF v-text-field add id="cpf-input", inputmode="numeric", maxlength="14"; on the phone v-text-field add id="phone-input", inputmode="numeric", maxlength="15". Replace v-model="formData.cpf" with v-model="cpfInput" and v-model="formData.phone" with v-model="phoneInput".

In RegisterComponent.vue add computed proxies cpfInput and phoneInput: getters return formData.cpf / formData.phone; setters store formatCpf(value) / formatPhone(value) into formData.cpf / formData.phone (masked string kept in state, same as RegisterEmployee).

In RegisterComponent.vue registrar(): build the request body as a normalized payload { ...this.formData, cpf: onlyDigits(this.formData.cpf), phone: onlyDigits(this.formData.phone) } and post THAT to '/auth/register' instead of raw this.formData. Leave validateForm() unchanged (masked non-empty strings still satisfy its truthiness/email/password checks).

Add src/components/MainView/__tests__/RegisterComponent.spec.ts mirroring src/components/GestorView/__tests__/RegisterEmployee.spec.ts: mount with a createVuetify() instance (register the v-components it uses), mock $api.post to resolve { status: 201 } and stub $router.push. Assert: typing 'abc12345678901234' into #cpf-input renders '123.456.789-01'; typing 'abc11987654321000' into #phone-input renders '(11) 98765-4321' and '1187654321' renders '(11) 8765-4321'; after setting name/email/password to valid values and calling registrar(), $api.post was called with '/auth/register' and an object whose cpf is '12345678901' and phone is '11987654321'.
acceptance_criteria: src/utils/masks.ts exists and is imported by both RegisterComponent.vue and RegisterEmployee.vue (single source of truth; no duplicated inline mask logic remains in RegisterEmployee.vue).
Running `npx vitest run src/components/MainView/__tests__/RegisterComponent.spec.ts` passes all new tests, proving the rendered input value contains punctuation and the posted payload is digits-only.
Running `npx vitest run src/components/GestorView/__tests__/RegisterEmployee.spec.ts` still passes unchanged (refactor is behavior-preserving).
No new npm dependency was added (package.json dependencies unchanged).
findings: Implemented. Shared util created at src/utils/masks.ts exporting pure onlyDigits/formatCpf/formatPhone (exact logic lifted from RegisterEmployee.vue). RegisterEmployee.vue now imports them (inline method bodies deleted; computed setters and registrar() call the imported fns); behavior-preserving, its existing spec still passes unchanged (3/3). RegisterComponent.vue: CPF field has id=cpf-input, inputmode=numeric, maxlength=14, v-model=cpfInput; phone field has id=phone-input, inputmode=numeric, maxlength=15, v-model=phoneInput; added computed proxies cpfInput/phoneInput storing the masked string in formData; registrar() posts a normalized payload { ...formData, cpf: onlyDigits(...), phone: onlyDigits(...) } to '/auth/register'; validateForm() untouched. New spec src/components/MainView/__tests__/RegisterComponent.spec.ts added (2/2 passing) and needs a small ResizeObserver polyfill at the top because RegisterComponent's Registrar button uses :loading (VProgressCircular) which relies on ResizeObserver, absent in jsdom; without the polyfill the test still passes but emits noisy unhandled rejections. No npm dependency added. VERIFICATION: `npm run type-check` has ONLY two pre-existing errors ($router on RegisterComponent.vue lines 119 & 246) that also exist on HEAD/baseline and are unrelated to this change (I verified by type-checking the original HEAD file); no new type errors from my changes. `npx vitest run` on both specs: 5/5 pass. `npm run lint:check` reports 132 pre-existing errors across unrelated files (ReportsPage.vue, regionPipeline.ts, soilRenderers.ts, etc.); eslint on my four touched files (masks.ts, RegisterComponent.vue, RegisterComponent.spec.ts, RegisterEmployee.vue) is clean (0 errors). No git commit created per instructions. NOTE for FEAT-002: this touched only RegisterComponent.vue, RegisterEmployee.vue, masks.ts and the new spec — PruningMap.vue is untouched and free for FEAT-002.
